description: Read a checkout session created with create_checkout: its status (open, pending, paid, paid_no_order, failed, expired), the frozen quote, and once paid the payment and the order with its tracking code. Poll it after handing the person the link, every few seconds, until it reports paid or expired. `pending` means a payment is being confirmed: tell the person to wait, never to pay again. `paid_no_order` means the money arrived as balance on the paying wallet's account but the order could not be placed; the person was told to contact support. Read-only and idempotent, so polling is safe.

token.description: The token from create_checkout's result. It is the session's bearer: whoever holds it can read the session and, while it is open, pay it, so do not post it anywhere but here and the person's own page_url.

name: get_checkout_status
